title: Discretization-independent operator learning for partial differential equations
abstract: arXiv:2507.07292v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a new and general encode-approximate-reconstruct operator learning model that leverages learned neural representations of bases for input and output function distributions. We introduce the concepts of numerical operator learning and discretization independence, which clarify the relationship between theoretical formulations and practical realizations of operator learning models. Our model is discretization-independent, making it particularly effective for multiresolution learning. We establish theoretical approximation guarantees, demonstrating uniform universal approximation under strong assumptions on the input functions and statistical approximation under weaker conditions. To our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive study that investigates how discretization independence enables robust and efficient multiresolution operator learning. translated_title: 面向偏微分方程的离散化无关算子学习
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种新颖且通用的“编码-近似-重构”算子学习模型，该模型利用学习到的神经表示作为输入和输出函数分布的基。我们引入了数值算子学习和离散化无关性的概念，阐明了算子学习模型的理论形式与实际实现之间的关系。我们的模型是离散化无关的，这使其在多分辨率学习中特别有效。我们建立了理论逼近保证，证明在输入函数的较强假设下具有一致泛逼近性，而在较弱条件下具有统计逼近性。据我们所知，这是首个全面研究离散化无关性如何实现鲁棒且高效的多分辨率算子学习的工作。我们通过大量数值实验验证了我们的方法，实验涉及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种离散化无关的“编码-近似-重构”算子学习模型，利用学习到的神经基表示实现偏微分方程求解中鲁棒且高效的多分辨率算子学习，并提供了统一泛逼近与统计逼近的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a discretization-independent encode-approximate-reconstruct operator learning model that leverages learned neural basis representations to enable robust and efficient multiresolution operator learning for PDEs, with theoretical guarantees of uniform and statistical approximation.
